method.description: Historical Baltic hybrid-threat backfill using the unified daily and rolling threat schema.
method.warning: Historical records are reconstructed from currently available scored items using published_at dates. The backfill is not a complete historical archive if older source items are no longer available.
method.daily_activity: Uses only events whose published_at date matches the displayed calendar date.
method.rolling_threat: Uses a 14-day rolling window ending on each displayed calendar date.

analytical_layers.information: Pure information or disinformation activity without a concurrent operational threat category.
analytical_layers.operational: Reported incidents and operational activities, including mixed events that contain a concrete operational threat component.

method.trend: Daily trend compares the current Daily Activity average score with the previous calendar day's Daily Activity average score.
method.history_retention: Unlimited. Historical daily records are never automatically removed.
method.backfill_update_mode: Only calendar dates inside the requested backfill range are rebuilt. Older and newer historical records outside that range remain unchanged.
method.important: Daily Activity and Rolling Threat are stored separately. The rolling window does not limit the lifetime of the historical database.
method.update_mode: One record per calendar date. Re-running the same date replaces only that date and preserves all other historical records.
